description: This file contains the implementation of the Currency class within the OpenCart system's cart library. It manages currency data, formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency information such as symbols, decimal places, and IDs.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class for handling currency data, formatting, and conversion in the OpenCart cart library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency class by fetching currency data from the database.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string with symbols and proper decimal points, with optional formatting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value from one currency to another based on stored conversion rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ID of a given currency code.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Gets the left symbol of a given currency.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Gets the right symbol of a given currency.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Gets the number of decimal places used for a given currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the conversion value of a given currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if the currency data exists for a given currency code.
